title: pdf
description: pdf/pdf.json, the record of make-pdf: what the look at each edition's proof found. The proofs are pdf/<lang>.pdf, printed by `artools render pdf` (which writes pdf/proof.json); `artools ship` prints the published PDFs again from content/.

verdict.description: issues: something prints wrong that the stage can't fix (a site bug), described in notes for the editor

rounds.description: how many times the proof was printed

checked.description: what each look covered and found

for_editor.description: anything the editor should see at gate 3, by page
